name: Palimpsest UV Lamp
note: A second, registered rendering of the folio sits under a radial mask-image that follows the lamp: under 365 nm the parchment fluoresces, the scraped undertext reads dark and turned 90°, and passing the lamp over a fragment transcribes it.

note: Ghosts are reflections mirrored through the optical centre, each an N-sided iris shape that rounds off wide open; the starburst has N spikes for an even blade count and 2N for an odd one, and the hill's coverage of the sun disc dims the whole flare.

name: Synchronous Fireflies
note: Pulse-coupled oscillators after Mirollo and Strogatz: each flash nudges the phase of nearby fireflies up a concave charging curve until the meadow flashes as one, and the Kuramoto order parameter r = |Σe^{iθ}|/N drives the readout and its trace.

name: Filament Dimmer
note: A push-to-switch rotary dimmer drives a tungsten model: filament temperature chases 2400 K·V^0.42 with a first-order thermal lag, power is V²/R with R ∝ T^1.2 (so a cold switch-on shows the real inrush), output follows T^8.1 and life V^−12, and the glow is the blackbody colour of the live temperature.

note: Three gelled fixtures are rendered into their own buffers, each with the performer's shadow cut out by destination-out, then summed with the lighter operator — so overlaps mix to cyan, magenta, yellow and white, and every shadow is lit by the other two lamps.
